rules-who.title: Allowed or not?

config.intro: You're a licensed amateur. Is each of these allowed?

cases.situation: Calling an Armed Forces station during an exercise.
cases.why: Talk only to stations under similar authorizations.

cases.situation: Adding an amplifier to a licence-exempt FRS radio.
Transmitting on a marine channel with your amateur handheld.
cases.why: Amateur equipment isn't certified outside the amateur bands.

cases.situation: Using your radio on land mobile frequencies; it's certified and licensed for land mobile.
cases.why: Allowed because it's certified and licensed for that service.

rules-who.success: Amateurs talk to amateurs, inside the amateur bands.
